evidence.quote: Today at Google Cloud Next, we are introducing the eighth generation of Google's custom Tensor Processor Unit (TPU), coming soon with two distinct, purpose-built architectures for training and inference: TPU 8t and TPU 8i.
TPU 8i pairs 288 GB of high-bandwidth memory with 384 MB of on-chip SRAM — 3x more than the previous generation — keeping a model's active working set entirely on-chip.
we doubled the Interconnect (ICI) bandwidth to 19.2 Tb/s. Our new Boardfly architecture reduces the maximum network diameter by more than 50%
Our new on-chip Collectives Acceleration Engine (CAE) offloads global operations, reducing on-chip latency by up to 5x
These innovations deliver 80% better performance-per-dollar compared to the previous generation

notes.zh:
回答「Google 第八代 TPU 里负责推理的是哪颗、为什么它更适合 agent 的低延迟场景」。8i 把单颗 HBM 提到 288GB、片上 SRAM 提到 384MB（前代 3 倍），配 19.2 Tb/s ICI 与 Boardfly 拓扑，把最大网络直径砍半；CAE 卸载全局通信，官方称片上延迟最多降 5 倍。单 pod 1,152 颗、FP8 11.6 EFLOPS、HBM 合计 331.8TB；官方称每美元性能提升 80%。
不主张：官方发布页没有给单颗 FP4 算力（行业转述为 10.1 PF，本卡不写）；11.6 EFLOPS 是 FP8 pod 合计，不是单颗；80% 与 5× 都是 Google 口径，不是独立实测；没有公开价格。
notes.en:
Answers which chip handles inference in Google's eighth-generation TPU line, and why it suits low-latency agent workloads. TPU 8i raises per-chip HBM to 288 GB and on-chip SRAM to 384 MB (3x the previous generation), pairs 19.2 Tb/s ICI with the Boardfly topology and more than halves the maximum network diameter, while the CAE offloads collective operations; Google says on-chip latency falls by up to 5x. A pod holds 1,152 chips, 11.6 FP8 exaflops and 331.8 TB of HBM; Google claims 80% better performance per dollar.
It does not claim: the launch page gives no per-chip FP4 figure (third-party reporting says 10.1 PF and is not written here); 11.6 EFLOPS is an FP8 pod total, not a single chip; the 80% and 5x figures are Google's, not independent measurements; no public pricing.

specs.定位 / role: 低延迟推理、采样与 agent 服务
